method: Built-in image generation; three full-assembly emphasis variants. Existing individual and reference assets preserved.

items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a fitting-picker ASSEMBLY variant of this exact existing HVAC assembly drawing showing 7A,7B,7C together. Preserve ALL assembly geometry, framing, floor decking cutaway, wooden studs/joists, panned passages, lower trunk and branches, perspective, proportions and margins. Remove the blue text labels 7A,7B,7C entirely, preserving nearby drawing lines. Keep the structural illustration thin black on pure white. The ONLY colored elements must be airflow arrows highlighting the selected fitting 7A: replace the TWO small straight DOWNWARD arrows inside the upper-left vertical stud cavity with much more prominent BOLD BLUE (#1677D2) arrows pointing downward in exactly the same cavity. Make their shafts approximately 3 times the existing arrow stroke and their filled triangular heads about twice the current size, clearly distinguishable at picker thumbnail size. Do NOT color any studs/panels or structural geometry. Keep all OTHER arrows small thin neutral gray or black in their existing positions/directions, including the curved turn at base, floor joist arrows and lower trunk arrows. No added arrows elsewhere. No text, legends, titles or colored background. Same full assembly image, with only 7A wall-flow emphasis.
items.reviewNote: Full assembly with bold blue downward arrows emphasizing the 7A wall stud-space run.

visualReview.comparison: Compared full assembly with the original restoration. Checked selected blue arrows, neutral context arrows, complete framing/deck/trunk, removed labels and source flow directions.

items.prompt: Use case precise-object-edit. Create another emphasis variant of this EXACT full HVAC assembly. Now emphasize ONLY 7B, the wall-to-floor TURN at the foot of that SAME vertical cavity. Replace the tiny black curved turn arrow at approximately x248 y430-460 (in this 1156x1361 image) with ONE prominent bold BLUE (#1677D2) smoothly curved arrow: tail descends inside lower wall cavity starting around (247,350), continues down to (247,425), then curves right/down-right into the connected floor passage ending around (330,488). Keep all other floor and trunk arrows small black. Exactly one blue curved arrow at the upper-left wall base.
items.reviewNote: Full assembly with a bold blue curved arrow emphasizing the 7B wall-to-floor turn.

visualReview.comparison: Compared full assembly with the original restoration. Checked selected blue arrows, neutral context arrows, complete framing/deck/trunk, removed labels and source flow directions.

items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a NEW '7C assembly merging-flow' variant from image 1 (clean full assembly with blue joist arrows). Image 2 is the original annotated source ONLY to locate the exact '40 Ft for merging flow' junction; do not reproduce its text. Preserve ALL existing assembly geometry, source perspective, floor cutaway, wood framing, lower ductwork and white margins. Keep the existing bold blue 7C arrows in floor joist bays and their exact directions. Add clear bold BLUE (#1677D2) emphasis to the UPSTREAM RETURN FLOW and its MERGE WITH THE JOIST RETURN at the near edge of the floor cutaway: the source's 40 Ft leader points to the joist-to-transverse-return junction around (590,625) in image 1, just above the long diagonal downstream trunk. Promote the existing small curved black flow arrow crossing the near exposed joist at that junction into a prominent smooth blue curved arrow feeding the downstream return trunk. Also promote the existing upstream return arrow on the transverse passage below the wall/floor junction (around 340,490 pointing DOWN-RIGHT toward the floor cutaway) to bold blue, showing the already-flowing upstream return approaching the merge. Promote the existing arrows immediately downstream of the merge along the diagonal return trunk (around 535,680 and 440,745, pointing DOWN-LEFT) to blue so the combined outgoing flow is clear. Keep direction faithful to source. This variant must visibly emphasize both incoming streams and the combined downstream path, not just the straight joist run. Other wall and lower vertical trunk arrows remain small black. Avoid inventing a new branch or adding geometry. No text, labels, numbers or colored framing; only selected airflow arrows blue. Same full assembly composition as image1.
items.reviewNote: Full assembly with bold blue arrows emphasizing upstream return flow, the merge and combined downstream flow. Floor-joist arrows are small and black. Merging flow adds 40 ft equivalent length to the airflow-based 7C value.

visualReview.comparison: All five highlighted floor-joist arrows are now small thin black arrows with source directions retained. Blue upstream approach, curved merge and combined downstream arrows remain prominent. Compared with previous artwork and user markup 7c.png.
